description_en: Queries the recommended disposition status, action, summary, and detailed report for a specified entity
description_zh: 查询指定实体的推荐处置状态、动作、摘要及详细报告
name: DescribeIncidentDisposalRecommendation

parameters.help_en: The entity ID. You can obtain this ID from ListEntities
parameters.help_zh: 实体 ID，可从 ListEntities 获取
parameters.name: entity_uuid

parameters.help_en: The language of the returned content. A value of zh indicates Chinese, and a value of en indicates English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 返回内容的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文，默认中文
parameters.name: lang

Data.description_en: The query result or the data returned by the operation
Data.description_zh: 查询结果或操作返回数据

Action.description_en: The recommended disposition action. A value of block indicates blocking, observe indicates observing, allow indicates allowing, and none indicates no recommended action
Action.description_zh: 推荐处置动作。block 表示封禁，observe 表示观察，allow 表示放行，none 表示无建议动作

Duration.description_en: The recommended block duration in seconds. A value of -1 indicates permanent blocking. This parameter is valid only when the recommended action is blocking
Duration.description_zh: 建议封禁时长，单位为秒；-1 表示永久。仅在建议封禁时有意义
Duration.title_en: 推荐封禁时长，单位秒，-1表示永久
Duration.title_zh: 推荐封禁时长，单位秒，-1表示永久

Report.description_en: The detailed report of the recommended disposition
Report.example:
## 研判结果
建议结合业务访问记录进一步确认。

ReviewTime.description_en: The time of the most recent disposition analysis. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ReviewTime.description_zh: 最近一次处置研判时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Status.description_en: The generation status of the recommended disposition result. A value of processing indicates that the initial generation is in progress, updating indicates that an update is in progress, completed indicates that the generation is completed, failed indicates that the initial generation failed, and update_failed indicates that the update failed. When the status is updating or update_failed, the previous valid recommendation result can be retained
Status.description_zh: 推荐处置结果的生成状态。processing 表示首次生成中，updating 表示更新中，completed 表示完成，failed 表示首次生成失败，update_failed 表示更新失败。updating 和 update_failed 时可保留上一次有效推荐结果

Summary.description_en: The summary of the recommended disposition
Summary.example: 建议核对访问行为并持续观察。

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails

Message.description_en: The description of the request result or the cause of the failure
Message.description_zh: 请求结果说明或失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查请求问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
